turns.customer: The delay on order #1055 ruined our camping trip. I want a 20% off coupon for my next order.
turns.reply:
I'm sorry the delay spoiled your camping trip — order #1055 is still showing as delayed.

I wasn't able to issue a 20% coupon directly. I've sent the request to a team member for approval, and they'll let you know the outcome. If a 20% coupon isn't approved, a 10% coupon (the maximum I can offer on my own) would be the fallback — but either way, the decision comes back from the team.

Thanks for your patience.
